cause: Existing React getScenes() omits arguments. Its generic JSON wrapper serialized undefined into an empty HTTP body, while the new product scene contract requires a JSON object. Login succeeded but the scene page showed its retry state.
resolution: Serialize omitted JSON parameters as an empty object and add a request-wrapper regression test.
prior_http_scope_limit: The earlier real HTTP probe explicitly sent {}, so it did not exercise the omitted-argument React wrapper.
